question: You visit pages A, then B, then C in a browser. You press Back twice. Which structure gives the right pages, in the right order?
options: A queue: first B, then C
A stack: first B, then A
A sorted list: first A, then B
explanation: Back always returns to the most recent page before the current one: last in, first out. From C, Back gives B, then A. That is a stack.
